source: Anastasia Kireeva, Randomstrasse 101, 2026-06-05, first displayed Open Problem 35
new_results: For upper gamma-negative-dependent forced supports, chi2(TP||Q) <= gamma^2*(exp(U)-1), with U <= rho_*^2*(Adv^{<=D})^2.
Order-profile bound: chi2(TP||Q) <= sum_k Gamma_k^2 U^k/k!.
Every unbiased pairwise-independent three-bit law has density 2^-3(1+theta y1y2y3), |theta|<=1; the sharp upper triple-cylinder ratio is 2.
Odd-parity forced-support exact spectrum at Q=Bern(1/2)^3: b1=3/4, b2=3/16, b3=1/16, chi2=1; marginal-matched independent chi2=61/64.

prior_art_update.details: Doerr-Gnewuch 2021 Definition 1.1 names upper gamma-negative dependence and correlation number; negative-cylinder MGF domination is standard. The forced-support low-degree inference translation is proved here but publication novelty is unverified.

failed_or_narrowed_routes: Pairwise dependence cannot replace all-cylinder control; the three-bit parity law is the exact first obstruction.
A single worst-cylinder gamma can be overly crude; order-by-order Gamma_k is the less wasteful algebraic quantity.
Large gamma alone does not imply distinguishability and is not a source counterexample.
Positive forced-support models still do not cover Mao's signed/cancellative rank construction.
method_menu_note: After this run only B29 remains genuinely unused in the 30-method menu; B27 and B24 are deliberately recycled nonconsecutive methods rather than falsely labeled unused.
